A '''mission''' took place during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in which [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] traveled to [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]] to apprehend [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and his mentor, [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]]. Sing and the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] were assisting the young Fett gain revenge against [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] who had killed Boba's father, [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango]], during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]]. The mission ended with Boba Fett and Bossk captured by the Jedi, and Sing presumed dead after crashing [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']] into the surface of Florrum.
